confirmations.verdict: Bounded probe strengthened; no new product requirement
confirmations.reason: The new five-second observation after loading occurs before the matching positive-control write, reducing the chance that the control advances the revision before a fire-and-forget side effect arrives. The unchanged requirement remains text-only saving/loading with no observable side effect, and the prompt retains its explicit finite-canary limitation. Five seconds is a bounded observation procedure, not proof that every possible server evaluation is absent.

The entire S24 protocol and its criterion descriptors are unchanged from repair1. Exact/padded collisions and empty/whitespace titles remain tested independently for NEW creation and current-revision update, using actual successful request shapes, positive controls and fresh unchanged-record readbacks.

All 64 Functional criterion objects and the complete Functional judge.toml are byte-identical to repair1. Error-message, source-line, rollback and subsequent Run credit retain separate owners. The total Functional weight remains 32.7; no positive control, refusal requirement or independent result was removed.

notes.topic: The server non-evaluation assurance exceeds this finite canary
notes.reason: The bounded monitor probe remains grounded in the public text-only storage requirement, but a non-fetch execution realm or an unprobed execution branch can leave its monitor unchanged. A successful browser write does not establish every potential server evaluation environment. The prompt accurately discloses this limit; no universal assurance is certified.

Those edits plausibly address source-location correctness; they are not criterion weakening. This scoped comparison does not certify all Promise semantics or the rebuilt bundle at runtime.

The fresh S09 control is now unconditionally explicit, and S21 adds a five-second passive observation before its existing positive-control write. The printed estimate sum is 450, versus repair1 436, but the increase belongs entirely to the unchanged S01 procedure and does not repair S21's estimate. Source size and action estimates are not measured configured-judge latency or launch argument size.
